integrity_note: All scientific formulas are derived for a specified model, with independently replayable rational checks; no independent audit or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed known stage count s>=3; equal independent exponential holding rates, homogeneous feedback probability, and exact raw moments. The fourth-moment-ratio inversion is cubically ill-conditioned at p near 1, but first-two-moment inversion is affine and is not subject to that particular limitation. No generic phase-type inequality, moment sample-size guarantee, or algorithm-wide optimality is asserted.
title: Exact inverse four-moment calibration and cubic sensitivity in cyclic Erlang phase-type models
